name: Ered Wethrin / Hithlum northern extent
problem: Hithlum is walled by Ered Wethrin on the east and south and Ered Lómin on the west, running up to Ered Engrin in the north. In the file both ranges stop near y 1045-1092, and the north_plain plateau (x 300-600, y 1100-1420) opens a 300 km plain between Hithlum and the Iron Mountains, so Hithlum has an open north side.
fix: Extend MT04 north from (580,1092): append (570,1160), (562,1240), (562,1310), (570,1380). Extend MT03 north from (330,1045): prepend (306,1380), (304,1300), (312,1200), (322,1110). Extend the 'hithlum' plateau to y 1380 between those ranges. Clip 'north_plain' to east of Ered Wethrin: [(600,930),(1200,930),(1320,1000),(1320,1420),(600,1420)].

name: Barad Eithel / Eithel Sirion (source of Sirion)
problem: Eithel Sirion is on the eastern face of Ered Wethrin, and Sirion flows from there outside Hithlum. The file puts Barad Eithel at (601,904) and Sirion's source at (598,905), on or west of the crest (x about 604 at that latitude), which puts the spring inside Hithlum.
fix: Move FT02 to (618,905). Change the first RI01 point to (616,905) and the second to (624,880), keeping the rest of the course.

name: Gates of Sirion / Falls of Sirion
problem: Sirion goes underground at the falls over Andram and comes out at the Gates three leagues (14.5 km) south. The file has them 24 km (5 leagues) apart, and the falls (655,490) sit 9 km north of the Andram line (y 481 at x 655).
fix: Move FA02 to (655,484) and CA01 to (655,469). End RI01 at (655,484) instead of (655,489), and start RI01b at (655,469) instead of (655,467).

name: Mindeb
problem: Dimbar lies between Sirion and the Mindeb, and the Mindeb bounds Doriath on the north-west. In the file the lower Mindeb, (672,640) and (654,628), runs inside the forest of Neldoreth and inside the Girdle.
fix: Reroute RI07 along the outside of the Girdle's north-west edge: [(716,722),(704,702),(686,686),(666,672),(651,662)]. The confluence stays south of the Brithiach and north of the Teiglin. Move the Dimbar label RG09 to (680,695).

name: Menegroth
problem: Menegroth stands on the south bank of the Esgalduin, in Region. The file puts it exactly on the river's bend vertex (790,625).
fix: Move TO01 to (793,617), which is inside Region and south of the river.

name: Amon Ethir
problem: Amon Ethir is a league (about 5 km) east of the doors of Nargothrond, across the Narog. In the file it is 15 km (3.2 leagues) from Nargothrond.
fix: Move HI06 to (494,567), with its points [(493,567),(495,567)], east of the Narog (x 492) and about 1 league from the doors (see TO02).

name: Nargothrond
problem: Nargothrond is in the west bank of the Narog, in the eastern face of Taur-en-Faroth. In the file it sits exactly on the river line (492,565).
fix: Move TO02 to (489,565). The Ringwil (RI16) can end at (492,565) as before.

name: Angband / Thangorodrim distance from Menegroth
problem: The text gives 150 leagues (724 km) from Angband to Menegroth. The file has 695 km (144 leagues).
fix: Move FT01 Angband to (770,1345). Move MT02 points to [(752,1365),(770,1355),(788,1365),(770,1381)] with its label at (770,1363), against the Ered Engrin wall.

name: Himlad
problem: Himlad lies between the Aros and the Celon. At the label's latitude (y 750) Aros is at x about 930 and Celon at about 966, so the label (936,750) sits almost on the Aros.
fix: Move RG12 to (948,748) and reduce its radius to 25.

name: Belegaer (the Great Sea)
problem: The sea west of Beleriand, which washes the Falas, Nevrast and Lammoth, has no label.

name: Dry River
problem: The Dry River, whose bed leads to the Orfalch Echor and the hidden way into Gondolin, is missing. It ran from the Echoriath west into Sirion near the Brithiach.
fix: Add river 'Dry River' (dry bed) [(681,722),(668,716),(656,712)], from the Orfalch Echor to Sirion just north of the Brithiach.

name: Celebros
problem: The stream of Brethil that falls at Nen Girith (Dimrost) into the Teiglin is missing, although Nen Girith is placed.

name: Dor Dínen
problem: The Silent Land between the upper waters of Esgalduin and Aros, north of Doriath, is missing.
fix: Add region 'Dor Dínen', tier 3, at (866,738) with radius 25.

name: Arthórien
problem: The land between Aros and Celon just above their confluence is missing.
fix: Add region 'Arthórien', tier 3, at (898,670) with radius 15.
